product_one_liner.value: CyberCube provides cloud-based cyber-risk modeling and analytics that help insurance organizations quantify cyber risk for insurance placement, underwriting, and aggregation management.

pricing_page.notes: The public site routes commercial inquiries to contact/demo and no public pricing page or plans were found.

employee_band.notes: The available employee count is 114, which falls in the 101–200 band.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists 2015 as the founding year; CyberCube describes becoming an independent company in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The software-development blog includes multiple engineering articles, including posts about migrating Lambda functions to ECS and graph-database document sharing.

public_docs.notes: The public help page is a support form and says user resources are in the secured account; it is not a public documentation library.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current openings list includes data and security-research roles, but none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: CyberCube’s CEO was reported as saying the company has used OpenAI models and APIs since 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The $180 million Series D was announced in October 2025, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current sales opening is Senior Director, (Re)Insurance Sales, not an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Recent announcements include an APAC regional benchmark addition to Broking Manager (October 2026) and a new AI-loss framework (September 2026).

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On February 9, 2026, Chris Methven was announced as CEO, succeeding Pascal Millaire.
